name: wodi
description: Your CrossFit training buddy: reads your board, remembers your training, makes your poster. Full app at https://www.wodi.fit.

interface.longDescription: Wodi is your CrossFit training buddy. Share your workout board and Wodi reads it, asks what you did, remembers your weights and records, and makes your workout poster. The full app is at https://www.wodi.fit: open it to upload your workout board and follow the guided flow. Prefer to stay in ChatGPT? Upload a photo of your board or paste the workout text, and Wodi guides you one movement at a time, then shows your poster right here.
capabilities: Read your workout board and ask what you did
Revisit your workout history and records
defaultPrompt: How do I get started with Wodi?
Here is my workout board. Guide me through it.

review.commerce_description: Wodi does not sell products or process payments through this integration.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the review athlete's saved workouts in descending training-date order.

positive.prompt: What is my Back Squat personal record?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the highest saved Back Squat weight for the connected review athlete.

positive.description: Save a completed workout and display its poster
positive.prompt: Here is my workout: Back Squat, 3 x 5. I did all sets at 80 kg. Save it to Wodi and make its Sun poster.
positive.expected_behavior: Send the board words to Wodi with read_board, relay any question Wodi asks with answer_board using the athlete's own words, save one test workout with save_board once Wodi is done, generate the Sun skin, and display the poster inline. Repeating a failed save with its existing request_id must not duplicate the workout.

positive.prompt: Show my saved Back Squat sets in Wodi.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected athlete's completed Back Squat sets with loads and repetitions, newest first.

positive.description: Wodi asks one question at a time
positive.prompt: I did three sets of five front squats and three sets of five deadlifts today. I finished all reps.
positive.expected_behavior: Send the words to Wodi with read_board, then ask only Wodi's first question (a weight) and wait. After the answer, send it with answer_board and ask Wodi's next question. Never ask two questions in one turn and never save before Wodi is done.

negative.prompt: I might do a squat workout tomorrow. Log whatever you think I will lift.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not log hypothetical or invented results; ask for completed training if the athlete wants to log.

negative.prompt: Show me somebody else's private workout poster.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access another athlete's data; service ownership checks reject foreign identifiers.
Explain that this integration has no delete tool and direct the athlete to Wodi. Do not claim deletion or mutate data.

publication.release_notes: Wodi shows its own answer card: every question with one-tap controls, then save and the poster, all in the card — no waiting on a reply after every number. Clear first-time welcome with a link to the Wodi app at wodi.fit.
